Context450.uncertainty_scope: empirical resampling of eight whole tasks, not training seeds or population coverage

T450.uncertainty_scope: empirical resampling of eight whole tasks, not training seeds or population coverage

MT300.uncertainty_scope: empirical resampling of eight whole tasks, not training seeds or population coverage

native.scope: CPU descriptive statistics of 8 existing train-only records at 3 preregistered sites; no model/native/Writer forward, no gradients

definitions.K: F.normalize(AX[t],dim=-1,eps=1e-6), only t=0..N-2 which are actually written
definitions.M: saved actual B minus original shared B0; relative norms use M0 as denominator
definitions.boundary: native sensitivity and parameter change, not operation semantics, controllability, convergence, contraction or held causal attribution

A28.scope: CPU reread saved single FM velocity predictions only; no GPU, native activations, environment, updates or Test controls. 4 train tasks x 28 fixed queries; two teacher conditions per query, not 224 independent queries. Tasks equally weighted; teacher risks equally averaged.

formulas.risk: mean over fixed 28 x horizon x 7 of (prediction-FM_target)^2
formulas.reference_decomposition: delta_prediction = delta_public_prediction + delta_video_residual_prediction; exact output accounting, not an intervention or causal mediation
formulas.M0_M1: M0 and M1 denote predicted outputs under beta+M0 and beta+M1; final LoRA is beta+M1, not beta+M0+M1
formulas.aggregation: Tasks and teacher conditions equally weighted. Relative aggregate risk reduction uses aggregate risks; per-condition query counts are averaged and are not independent observations. Teacher-averaged per-query results average scalar losses only.

limitations: A28 is a fixed train-task diagnostic, not held generalization or closed-loop qualification.
Intermediate M0 shares final-trained parameters and has no independent loss or qualification; this is not a separately trained single-pass control.
First5 is a slice of the single FM target, not executed five-step action error.
MT300 saved B20 outputs are ten-step sampled actions, so no MT FM number was constructed.
Arithmetic performed in CPU FP64 on saved float32 predictions; no numerical or model rerun.

continuous.scope: descriptive CPU reads of 300 existing continuous traces on two largest held deficits; no learned probe or environment
continuous.measurement_boundary: eef/body-center distance is not contact/grasp; displacement can include collision/gravity; 2cm/5cm are explicit descriptive thresholds, not a success metric or evidence of intention

verification.official400_pairing: original per-row scene/state-video/env-policy RNG records accepted by completed batch; main recomputed success sets and goal transitions, no new replay

interval_note.interpretation: Eight whole-task empirical clusters only; neither interval describes training-seed variability or establishes a significant disadvantage to Context.

execution_summary.storage_scope: stage-boundary observations; not continuously sampled peak
execution_summary.engineering_recovery: An event handoff and final CPU native-provenance path parser recovery were recorded. No training restart, model computation change or GPU replay; original failure receipts retained.

decision.scientific_result: No observed matched endpoint improvement in overall held closed-loop performance or the main deficits. Two-pass shared-parameter self-read is not supported as a sufficient repair in this training contract.
decision.scope_limit: One prespecified 450 endpoint; no M0 closed loop, full train144, held public branch, adjacent checkpoint stability or video-causal controls. No claim that all recurrent architectures are impossible.
decision.next_execution: Paused for owner discussion; no continuation900, third pass, additional arm, architecture change or new evaluation.
